paragraphs: Talk Commerce records your interview with your team on the ground at your event. A superstar writer at Content Cucumber turns that conversation into blog articles, social clips, case studies, SEO content, and whatever your heart can dream up.
We have three packages and we limit each event to 8 interviews, with paid interviews booked first. See our full conference video production service.
Interviews can be done in Spanish if you prefer.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: We make this as easy as pie. We don't write hard-to-follow scripts. Instead, we ask questions that draw out your deep knowledge of the subject. We find you in the conference center (or you find us!) and do the interview. I would encourage you to listen to our episodes.

items.question: When will we receive the final content?
items.answer: Video clips and published episodes within two weeks. Written content (blog articles, case studies) within three weeks. Rush delivery available.

items.question: Can we use the footage for our own marketing?
items.answer: Yes. You receive all clips, raw footage, and full permission to use them across your channels.

items.question: Which conferences do you cover?
items.answer: We cover major ecommerce and B2B conferences across the US, including Shop Talk, eTail, and industry-specific shows. Tell us which event you're attending and we'll confirm availability.

data.title: Ready to book your interview?
data.text: 8 slots per event, and paid interviews get first pick of times. Tell us which conference you're attending and which package you want. PR agencies: see our agency content services.
